description: One case per toggle: the estate with flowsWithoutFailedRunAlert on and nothing else. The known answer is F-FAILED-RUN-ALERT, the Finding of Check FAILED-RUN-ALERT, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: flowsWithoutFailedRunAlert, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.sh fixed, then infra/as-found.sh flowsWithoutFailedRunAlert=carrier-tracking
setup.note: if a run or message also failed, the Finding that pairs the failure with the missing alert may join; the case allows it

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: A Logic App has no failed-run alert. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
